integrity: The proof and finite verifier support only the specified claim. Earlier published papers already establish the long-horizon spectral-gap design; no novelty is claimed for that specialization. External independent mathematical review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only unnormalized continuous-time symmetric weighted paths with an equal unit price per edge, fixed total budget and n>=4; no complete finite-time optimizer formula, no unique-crossing assertion, and the 6/5 factor applies to a short-time quadratic coefficient, not heat traces.
title: A one-fifth short-horizon penalty and a universal edge-priority reversal in optimal path diffusion
